persons.name: Devadatta
persons.evidence: maulyaṃ datvā brāhmaṇāya gṛhītaṃ dīrghadarśinā | devadattadvijendreṇa

purpose: putrahetave (purchased for the sake of his son for six coins / ṣaṇmudrā)
notes: Devadatta purchased the manuscript (foliated with 354 leaves: 'vedabāṇāgnipatrakaṃ') from an unnamed brāhmaṇa for six mudrās for the sake of his son.
